title: Mol-JEPA embedding pipeline
description: Generate Mol-JEPA embeddings for HDD compounds.

downloads.description: Optional downloads YAML. Defaults to the bundled HDD v3 sources.

embeddings.description: Optional embeddings YAML. Defaults to CPU.

raw_data.description: Optional directory containing HDD/colData.tsv and HDD/Tox21.tsv. Use a dx://project-ID:/folder URI on DNAnexus.

molset.description: Optional text file with one HDD compound ID per line. Otherwise build the molecule universe.

container_image.description: Docker registry image digest or dx://project-ID:file-ID for a Docker archive. Required on DNAnexus.

outdir.description: Output subdirectory. Use a relative path on DNAnexus.
